subject: Update on Your Recent Job Application
body: Dear [Name], Thank you for submitting your application for the [Job Title] position at [Company Name]. We wanted to inform you that the hiring process is still ongoing, and we appreciate your patience. Our team is currently reviewing all applications thoroughly to ensure a fair selection process. Rest assured that we will notify you of any updates or next steps as soon as possible. If you have any questions in the meantime, feel free to reach out to us. Best regards, [Your Name]
